definitions.explanation: The up-down direction, or the longer dimension of a rectangular object. Contrasts with {横|よこ} (horizontal, width).

examples.japanese: {縦|たて}に{並|なら}んでください。
この{箱|はこ}は{縦|たて}30センチ、{横|よこ}20センチだ。
examples.english: This box is 30 cm long and 20 cm wide.

examples.japanese: {日本語|にほんご}は{縦|たて}{書|が}きでも{横|よこ}{書|が}きでも{書|か}ける。
examples.english: Japanese can be written both vertically and horizontally.

notes:
USAGE:
- {縦|たて}に: vertically, lengthwise
- {縦|たて}の: vertical ~

COMPOUNDS:
- {縦|たて}{書|が}き: vertical writing
- {縦|たて}{長|なが}: portrait orientation, taller than wide
- {縦|たて}{横|よこ}: length and width; all directions
- {縦|たて}{線|せん}: vertical line
- {縦|たて}{列|れつ}: column (vertical row)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{縦|たて} (vertical, length) ↔ {横|よこ} (horizontal, width). These are frequently used as a pair.
